text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them catch problems early and design cleaner solutions. Although writing tests takes extra time, it gives developers real confidence. They can change the code without fear of breaking things, and they know their work is reliable. In short, testing is not a waste of time — it is an investment in quality.
